descriptor.name: Vilnius public cadastral parcel polygons
descriptor.operator: Lithuanian INSPIRE Geoportal / National Land Service
descriptor.scope: Public cadastral parcel geometry around the unchanged Vilnius WUP settlement locator. Thirteen aligned cells and 7 unique full parcels passed stable counts, complete paging, fresh native-ID geometry reads, correctly shaped explicit absence and full-parcel one-parcel binding. Root independent EPSG:32635 GEOS audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The WUP locator is covered by LT-INSP-CADASTRAL-440051231650. Evidence is bounded and does not establish citywide or nationwide completeness, survey precision, legal ownership or currentness.
descriptor.attribution: Lithuanian INSPIRE Geoportal / National Land Service · cadastral references · adapted
descriptor.licenceNote: Publisher conditions, legal effect and update schedule are informational. Public native parcel IDs and geometry only; ownership is not imported.
